title: Visual Studio Code – Guided Basics
description: Learn the most important parts of the VS Code interface, including the Primary and Secondary Side Bar, then practise a simple work context with one folder, files, the editor and the additional panel area.

open_explorer.title: Open Explorer
open_explorer.description: You now know the roles of the Activity Bar, Primary Side Bar, Secondary Side Bar and Explorer. Next, open the file and folder view yourself.
open_explorer.instruction: Open Explorer using its icon in the Activity Bar.
open_explorer.rationale: The Activity Bar selects the main area; its content appears in the Primary Side Bar. The Secondary Side Bar remains separate and can host additional views.
helpLevels: Look for the Explorer icon in the narrow Activity Bar on the far left.
Select the top icon showing two files.
The Explorer icon is highlighted. Select exactly that icon.
open_explorer.highlightTooltip: Explorer: files and folders in the current work context.
open_explorer.successMessage: Explorer opened. The Activity Bar and Primary Side Bar have different roles; the Secondary Side Bar is a separate additional area.
